subject: CFRunLoopSourceContext

observation.summary: CoreFoundation ships no standalone Mach-O on macOS 27 (/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/CoreFoundation is a broken symlink); its image is resident in the arm64e dyld shared cache (sha256 ecc822c56dbce82d0f151afd7bf8492e91b109944483614f0eaaf377ac7d21da), so otool-exports and nm-symbols both return status=tool-failed against this path. dyld_info resolves the canonical path through the cache and reads the image's LC_DYLD_EXPORTS_TRIE directly. source_artifact is the verbatim dyld_info export dump captured to the cache directory, which is the observed artifact. CFRunLoopSourceContext is a struct and emits no symbol in the export trie; it is passed by pointer to _CFRunLoopSourceCreate and returned by _CFRunLoopSourceGetContext, both of which are exported.

(no CFRunLoopSourceContext symbol; see _CFRunLoopSourceCreate in mirror header)

claim: CFRunLoopSourceContext is a versioned callback-vtable struct that carries the perform/schedule/cancel callbacks for a run-loop source; it has no Mach-O symbol of its own and is exchanged by pointer through the exported CFRunLoopSourceCreate and CFRunLoopSourceGetContext functions.
